name: Advanced Strength · 5 Days
summary: Forge Strength V2 (A-S5): five strength sessions a week for advanced lifters.
description: Forge Strength V2 program A-S5. Sessions: Squat Strength; Bench Strength; Deadlift + Pull; Bench Volume + Upper; Lower Technique. Listed sets are working sets; warm-up sets are separate. Unilateral prescriptions are per side. Rest about 3–5 minutes after primary lifts, 2–3 minutes after secondary compound lifts and 1–2 minutes after accessory work.
progression: Eight-week autoregulated progression. Heavy compound lifts take priority; secondary lifts support them without matching their fatigue. Weeks 1–3: primary lifts at 2–3 RIR, secondary lifts at 3–4 RIR. Week 4: a planned lower-fatigue week with about 35% fewer working sets at 3–4 RIR, adjustable to your recovery. Weeks 5–7: primary lifts at 1–2 RIR, secondary lifts at 2–3 RIR. Week 8: a reduced-volume performance check with about 30% fewer working sets at 1–3 RIR, no load increase and no maximal attempts. Load rises when every working set reaches the top of the range at the target effort, or when every set is clearly easier than the target. Effort harder than the target holds the load, and repeated missed reps suggest a reduction. Heavy and lighter practice sessions progress separately.

phases.name: Weeks 1–3 · Accumulation
phases.notes: Accumulate quality work and increase load only where your recorded sets earn it.

exercises.notes: Weighted pull-up: add external load when appropriate.

phases.name: Week 4 · Lower fatigue
phases.notes: Planned lower-fatigue week: about 35% fewer working sets at 3–4 RIR. The sets shown are the normal baseline. Train normally instead if your recovery is good.

exercises.notes: Weighted pull-up: add external load when appropriate.

phases.name: Weeks 5–7 · Strength
phases.notes: Resume heavier, strength-focused progression where your recorded sets earn it.

exercises.notes: Weighted pull-up: add external load when appropriate.

phases.name: Week 8 · Performance check
phases.notes: Reduced-volume performance check: about 30% fewer working sets than shown, at the target effort. No load increase, maximal attempts or grinding reps; no 1RM test is required.

exercises.notes: Weighted pull-up: add external load when appropriate.
